form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
length: 6 months (April 15 to October 15)
payment_threshold: None - full tax due by original date regardless of extension

filer: Corporations, S corps, partnerships, estates & trusts (Forms 1120, 1120-S, 1065, 1041, 1042)
form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File Certain Business Income Tax, Information, and Other Returns
length: 6 months (period varies by specific return - confirm against current Form 7004 instructions)
payment_threshold: None - full tax due by original date regardless of extension

filer: Exempt organizations & governmental entities (Form 990 series, Form 5330)
form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File an Exempt Organization Return
length: 6 months
payment_threshold: None - any excise tax due still due by original date

form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File a Return and/or Pay U.S. Estate (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Taxes
length: 6 months to file (automatic); payment extension discretionary under IRC 6161
payment_threshold: Payment extension requires reasonable cause shown to the IRS - not automatic

form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File Information Returns
automatic: Conditional - automatic for most covered returns; NOT automatic for Form W-2
length: 30 days
payment_threshold: N/A

filer: U.S. citizens/residents with tax home and abode outside the US and Puerto Rico
form: None required (automatic); Form 2350 for FEIE qualification extension
form_name: Automatic 2-month extension for taxpayers abroad; Form 2350 for additional time to qualify for the foreign earned income exclusion
length: 2 months automatic (to June 15); Form 2350 extends further for FEIE qualification only
payment_threshold: None required to obtain the extension, but interest accrues on unpaid tax from April 15

form_name: Automatic extension - no application form; use FTB 3519 only to submit a payment
length: 6 months (to October 15, 2026, for the 2025 tax year)
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original April 15 date regardless of extension; use FTB 3519 to pay by mail

filer: Corporations, S corps, exempt organizations, LLCs, partnerships (Forms 100, 100S, 100W, 199, 565, 568)
form: None required (automatic); payment vouchers FTB 3539 (corps/exempt orgs), FTB 3537 (LLCs), FTB 3538 (partnerships/REMICs)
form_name: Automatic extension - no application required; payment voucher only if tax is owed
length: 7 months for corporations/exempt organizations (Form 100/100W/199); 6 months for S corporations (Form 100S), partnerships, and LLCs
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original due date regardless of extension

form_name: Application for Automatic Six-Month Extension of Time to File for Individuals
length: 6 months (to October 15, 2026, for the 2025 tax year)
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original due date; the extension request itself must be filed by the original due date to be valid

form_name: Request for Six-Month Extension to File (franchise/business tax return)
length: 6 months
payment_threshold: Properly estimated tax must be paid with the extension request to avoid penalty

tax_type: Franchise tax (no individual income tax in Texas)
filer: Taxable entities filing the Texas Franchise Tax Report
form_name: Texas Franchise Tax Extension Request
length: To August 17, 2026 (first extension); to November 16, 2026 for entities required to pay by electronic funds transfer (EFT) that make a second extension payment
payment_threshold: Must pay 100% of the tax due for the prior year, or 90% of the tax that will be due for the current year, with the extension request

tax_type: Corporate income tax (no individual income tax in Florida)
form_name: Florida Tentative Income/Franchise Tax Return and Application for Extension of Time to File Return
length: 6 months (7 months for June 30 fiscal-year filers with tax years beginning before January 1, 2026)
payment_threshold: Must pay 100% of the tentatively determined tax due with F-7004; the extension is void if the underpayment exceeds the greater of $2,000 or 30% of the tax shown on the return when filed (Fla. Stat. §220.32)

form: None required (automatic); Form IL-505-I only to submit a payment
form_name: Automatic Extension Payment for Individuals
length: 6 months (to October 15, 2026, for the 2025 tax year); an Illinois extension longer than 6 months is allowed to match a federal extension that exceeds 6 months
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original April 15 date regardless of extension

form: None required (automatic); Form IL-505-B only to submit a payment
form_name: Automatic Extension Payment for Corporations, Partnerships, and Fiduciaries
length: 7 months (8 months for June 30 fiscal-year corporations)
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original due date regardless of extension

form: REV-276 (only if PA tax is owed, or no federal extension was granted)
form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File
length: 6 months
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original date. If a federal extension was granted and no PA tax is owed, no REV-276 is required.

filer: Individuals (NJ-1040, NJ-1040NR, NJ-1080C); estates and trusts (NJ-1041)
form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File New Jersey Gross Income Tax Return
length: 6 months for individual returns; 5.5 months for fiduciary returns (NJ-1041)
payment_threshold: At least 80% of the total tax liability must be paid by the original due date (via withholding, estimated payments, or the payment submitted with NJ-630), or the extension is void

tax_type: Personal income, fiduciary, and partnership tax
filer: Individuals (Form 1); estates and trusts (Form 2, via M-8736); partnerships (Form 3)
form_name: Application for Automatic Six-Month Extension of Time to File Massachusetts Income Tax Return
automatic: Conditional - automatic for individuals/fiduciaries only if 80% of tax liability is paid by the original due date; partnerships (Form 3) get an automatic 6-month extension with no payment condition
length: 6 months
payment_threshold: At least 80% of the total tax liability must be paid by the original due date or the automatic extension is void. Extension payments of $5,000 or more must be made electronically.

tax_type: Individual and school district income tax
form: None required (automatic with a federal extension)
form_name: No separate Ohio extension form - a copy of the federal extension is filed with the Ohio return
length: Matches the federal extension period (to October 15, 2026 for calendar year 2025 returns with a federal extension)
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but tax due, interest, and penalty are unaffected - full tax is still due by the original date unless the Tax Commissioner expressly extends the payment date
authority: Ohio Rev. Code §5747.08; Ohio Admin. Code §5703-7-05

tax_type: Business and occupation (B&O) / excise tax (no individual or corporate income tax in Washington)
filer: Businesses filing the Combined Excise Tax Return
form: None - request made directly through My DOR, phone, or secure email; not a form-based extension
form_name: Excise tax return filing extension (discretionary, good-cause based)
length: Most extensions are less than 30 days; longer or permanent extensions beyond 10 days require a deposit and are granted only for good cause (system failure, lost records, medical emergency, natural disaster)
payment_threshold: Extensions beyond 30 days (or permanent extensions beyond 10 days) require a deposit equal to the estimated tax liability for the period; financial hardship is not a qualifying reason

form: None required if a federal extension was filed; Form OR-40-V with Publication OR-40-EXT if paying without a federal extension
form_name: Automatic extension (matches federal); payment voucher only if tax is owed
length: 6 months (to October 15, 2026 for the 2025 tax year)
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but tax is still due April 15, 2026
authority: Or. Rev. Stat. §314.385; Or. Admin. Code §150-314-0167

form: Federal Form 7004 (Oregon has no separate corporate extension form)
form_name: Use federal Form 7004; mark 'for Oregon only' if no federal extension is needed
length: 15 days after the federal extended due date
payment_threshold: Estimated tax payment rules still apply if $500 or more is expected to be owed; extension does not defer payment

form: Form IT-303 (only if no federal extension); a copy of Form 4868/7004 or the IRS confirmation letter if a federal extension was obtained
form_name: Application for Extension of Time for Filing State Income Tax Returns
length: Up to 6 months, matching the federal extension period
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but the extension does not extend the time to pay - use Form IT-560 to remit tax due by the original due date

form: Form D-410 (only if no federal extension); certify the automatic federal extension on the NC return if one was granted
form_name: Application for Extension for Filing Individual Income Tax Return
length: 6 months (4 months for out-of-country filers, plus 2 more if D-410 is filed by August 15)
payment_threshold: No payment is required to obtain the extension, but late-payment penalty is avoided only if at least 90% of the tax liability is paid through withholding or estimated payments by the original due date

form: None required (automatic); Form 760IP only to submit a payment
form_name: Automatic Extension Payment Voucher for Individuals
length: 6 months (to November 1, 2026, for the 2025 tax year; Virginia's original due date is May 1)
payment_threshold: At least 90% of the total tax liability must be paid by the original May 1 due date to avoid the extension penalty; interest still accrues on any unpaid balance

filer: Individuals (MI-1040); corporations (Michigan Corporate Income Tax return)
form: Form 4 (if no federal extension, or to submit payment)
form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File Michigan Tax Returns
length: Matches the new federal due date once Treasury receives the extension request
payment_threshold: An estimated payment of the remaining tax due must be submitted with a copy of the federal extension (or Form 4) by the original due date; this is a filing extension only, not a payment extension

form_name: No extension form - automatic
length: Individual: 6 months (to October 15). Corporate: federal extension period plus 1 month
payment_threshold: Not extended; interest and penalties accrue on unpaid tax from the original due date

form_name: Application for Filing Extension for Individuals
length: Individual: 6 months. Corporate: up to 7 months
payment_threshold: At least 90% of the tax liability must be paid by the original due date to avoid the extension underpayment penalty (0.5% per 30-day period)

form: Form AR1055 (only if no federal extension applies)
form_name: Request for Extension of Time for Filing Income Tax Returns
length: 1 month beyond the federal extended due date (to November 15 for calendar-year filers)
payment_threshold: Not extended; interest and failure-to-pay penalty accrue from the original due date

form: None required (DR 0158-I/DR 0158-C are payment vouchers only)
form_name: No extension form - automatic
length: 6 months (to October 15)
payment_threshold: At least 90% of net tax liability must be paid by the original due date to avoid penalty; interest still accrues on any unpaid balance

form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File Connecticut Income Tax Return for Individuals
length: 6 months (to October 15)
payment_threshold: Automatic only if no additional CT tax is owed and a federal extension was requested; otherwise the tentative tax must be paid with Form CT-1040 EXT by the original due date, or a 10% penalty applies to the underpaid amount
authority: Conn. Agencies Regs. §12-723-1; Conn. Gen. Stat. §12-222

form_name: Application for Automatic Extension
length: 6 months (to October 15)
payment_threshold: Not extended; interest and penalties accrue on unpaid tax from the original due date

form_name: No extension form - automatic
length: 6 months (to October 20)
payment_threshold: The properly estimated tax liability must be paid by the original due date; underpayment can void the extension for penalty purposes

form: None required (Form 51 is a payment voucher only)
form_name: No extension form - automatic
length: 6 months (to October 15)
payment_threshold: 80% of the current-year estimated tax, or 100% of the prior year's total tax, paid by the original due date

form: Form IT-9 (only if no federal extension)
form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File
length: Matches the federal extended due date
payment_threshold: At least 90% of the state and local income tax due must be paid by the original due date to avoid penalty

form_name: No extension form - automatic
length: 6 months (to October 31)
payment_threshold: At least 90% of the tax required to be shown on the return must be paid by the original due date
authority: Iowa Code §422.21; Iowa Admin. Code r. 701-700.5

form: None - attach a copy of federal Form 4868
form_name: No separate Kansas extension form
length: Matches the federal extended due date (to October 15)
payment_threshold: At least 90% of the tax due must be paid, postmarked by the original due date

form: None if federal extension attached; else Form 40A102
form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File
length: 6 months (12 months if abroad)
payment_threshold: Not extended; unpaid tax must be submitted by the original due date to avoid interest and penalties

form_name: No extension form - automatic
length: 6 months (to November 15)
payment_threshold: Not extended; interest and penalties accrue on unpaid tax from the original May 15 due date

form_name: No separate Maine extension form
length: Equivalent to the federal extension period
payment_threshold: Not extended; interest accrues on unpaid tax from the original due date
